lines.en: label mayaspringshrinegen2:
scene mayaspringshrinegen2
It's no secret that my relationship with Maya is complicated. So much so that, even now that I can face her here, I'm still haunted by her ghostly reflection as it traipses across the shrine grounds.
lines.zh: 我和 Maya 的关系很复杂，这不是什么秘密。复杂到即便现在我敢在这儿面对她，我依然被她那幽灵般的倒影缠着——她在神社境内游荡。

lines.en: I can almost hear her nagging me. Telling me that this girl I once viewed as a puppet is exactly that. And that I'm just as weak as ever for crumbling at the faintest hint of her smile.
lines.zh: 我几乎能听见她在我耳边唠叨。告诉我：这个我曾经当成提线木偶的女孩，就是个提线木偶。而我依旧那么软弱，她嘴角刚露出一点笑意，我就塌了。

lines.en: But I also think she'd get it. Because if there's anyone who'd fall for Maya (other than me), it's Maya herself. And this is Maya. I can't lie to myself about that anymore.
lines.zh: 但我也觉得她会懂。因为如果说这世上还有谁会迷上 Maya（除了我），那就是 Maya 自己。而这正是 Maya。这一点我再也骗不了自己了。

lines.en: It's just a different phase of her existence. Which means this is all equally as tough for her because, from her perspective, I'm the same exact way.
lines.zh: 这只是她存在的不同阶段。也就是说，这对她同样艰难，因为在她眼里，我也一模一样。

lines.en: There's just one problem, though.
Well, honestly, there are many problems.
But the main problem is that there's something about her that none of us understand yet. And it doesn't help that we don't understand why we don't understand either.
lines.zh: 但主要的问题是：她身上有某种我们谁都还不明白的东西。而我们连「为什么不明白」都不明白，这更是雪上加霜。

lines.en: She's important. Not just to me, but to Kumon-mi. And she likely always has been. But if she can't tell us why, there's no way I'll find the answer by just looking at her.
lines.zh: 她很重要。不只是对我，对 Kumon-mi 也是。而且大概一直都很重要。可如果她不能告诉我们为什么，我光是看着她是不可能找到答案的。

lines.en: It'd be great if I could, though. Because I can't take my eyes off of hers. And if gazing into them granted me the knowledge I wanted, I'd be the smartest man to ever live instead of his polar opposite.
lines.zh: 不过我要是能就好了。因为我没法把视线从她眼睛上移开。如果凝视它们就能给我想要的知识，我会成为有史以来最聪明的人，而不是他的反面。

lines.en: I don't think she'd like me anymore if that was the case, though.
lines.zh: 不过我想，要是那样，她就不会再喜欢我了。

lines.en: I'm better for her broken. Which is precisely how she's better for me too since we're both terrible people at the end of the day.
lines.zh: 我破碎着，对她才更好。而她破碎着，对我也更好，因为说到底我俩都是糟糕的人。

lines.en: It's a dynamic that perfectly mirrors the place we inhabit — that will go on and on for all eternity.
lines.zh: 这种相处方式，完美映照了我们栖身的这个地方——它会一直、一直延续到永远。

lines.en: scene black
Until it just...doesn't anymore.
lines.zh: 直到某天它就这么……不再延续。

lines.en: When that day comes, will I still be able to drown myself in aquamarine?
lines.zh: 那一天到来时，我还能把自己溺死在那片蓝绿色里吗？

lines.en: Or will I join her ghost across a bridge of magpies?
lines.zh: 还是会踏上鹊桥，去跟她的幽灵会合？

Maya’s affection has increased to [maya_love]!
lines.zh: Maya 的好感度提升到了 [maya_love]！
